title: Wall Mount Tumbler Toothbrush Holder 5-Inch Projection Solid Brass, Mambo Collection | Antique Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving storage at the sink with this wall mount tumbler toothbrush holder, crafted from solid brass in Antique Brass, features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. Designed for the Mambo collection, it fits transitional bathroom hardware plans and pairs easily with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Multiple designer finish options available
- Installation hardware included

Specs:
- Category: Tumbler Toothbrush Holders
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 4.5 in (L) x 3.5 in (W) x 4.7 in (H)
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
- Included items: Toothbrush holder and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
